title: Message actor
description: Who or what a producer acted for. Customer participants never inherit client-staff access, and model roles never impersonate a person whose evidence informed their proposal.

oneOf.title: Customer participant
oneOf.description: The client-scoped participant. Validation always requires the original client_user_id; no colleague, client staff member, or second account may substitute.

oneOf.title: Client member
oneOf.description: Client staff. Owners and admins configure policy and may invoke the deny-only case stop; they cannot edit, approve, or resume product lifecycle state.

oneOf.title: uTrace agent role
oneOf.description: A cognitive role whose results are advisory. The pinned versioned model identity travels with the message, never a bare model alias.

role.description: GPT-Live handles voice, Terra interactive reasoning and retrieval, Sol deep investigation and coding, Jev intake decisions and concurrent semantic attention.

model_version.description: The pinned versioned model or deployment identity used for this result.

oneOf.title: Provider identity
oneOf.description: An external provider identity. Provider identifiers stay scoped strings and never become primary product identity.

external_id.description: The provider's own identifier for the acting principal or resource.

installation_ref.description: The provider installation this identity belongs to.

oneOf.title: Service
oneOf.description: An internal uTrace service acting under its own scoped identity. No shared all-powerful credential exists.

oneOf.title: System
oneOf.description: The platform itself: scheduled maintenance, lease scans, reconciliation, and expiry. It carries no delegated human or provider identity.
